title: console list and record pages: meta/view waits 440-845 ms after the app bundle for route chunks to load; start it from the route beside the chunks
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZrgaiMgTJCnswR6jQ

Filing gate: ③ a measured finding of the #35455 dev (os-dev-report 7012178512, item 3), measured on `origin/main` `92121196` with the built console, 12 loads. It is a child of #35455 (console first-screen round trips, p1) and is nested under it.
Reader: `domain:ui` (app-shell route and object view). Suggested grade: p1, the parent's grade.
Dedupe: `meta/view prefetch route`, `lazy chunk before view`, `ObjectView view read after chunk`. Only #35455 matches.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：列表页和记录页的数据更早开始加载，首屏等待少约半秒到一秒。
- 为什么做：托管环境打开页面要 9–10 秒，这是首屏串行里一段没有请求在跑的空等。
- 出错会怎样：视图定义和数据不变，只提前发出；撤回即可。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Facts

- From the app bundle answering to `meta/view?object=…` leaving: list page 693/845/763 ms cold and 774/786/842 ms warm; record page 523/499/439 ms cold. No request is in flight in that gap; the plugin-view, plugins-views, plugin-form and plugin-list chunks load in it.
- The view read is issued from inside `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`, a lazy route chunk in `console/AppContent.tsx`, only after the post-bundle render and those chunks.
- The record page's own data read already leaves before `meta/view`; the list's first data page needs the view (select and sort), so it stays one hop behind it.

## Ask

Start `meta/view?object=OBJECT` from the route level as soon as the app's object scope has the bundle and the route's object, into the metadata cache `ObjectView` joins on mount, so it runs beside the chunk loads. Pin that the view read is issued while the chunk import is pending, and that `ObjectView` sends no second view read. Measure layers before and after (method of #34211 / #35455). About 150-300 lines in app-shell.

⛔ Not a claim.
